description.value: India Delight Bistro & Bar is a North Indian and Mughlai restaurant on Sooke Road serving authentic curries, tandoori dishes, and Indo-Chinese appetizers for dine-in or takeout. Chef Data Ram Bhaat brings experience from kitchens in India, Singapore, and Germany, with a focus on freshly prepared sauces and handpicked herbs and spices. The restaurant also offers catering for events of 50 or more people, making it a notable stop in an otherwise limited dining corridor west of Victoria.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms the business is a real, open Indian restaurant at 6676 Sooke Rd, Sooke, BC. The phone number on the website (+1 778-352-1111) matches the OSM tag. The website explicitly mentions takeout/pickup ordering and lists multiple vegetarian menu items (Vegetable Samosa, Onion Bhaji, Veg Pakora, Veg Manchurian, Chilli Paneer, Chilli Soya Chaap), confirming those amenities. No bike parking, washroom, water, or Wi-Fi information appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM address field is empty; address sourced from website only (6676 Sooke Rd, Sooke, BC V9Z 0A5).

The /about/ page contains the default WordPress placeholder text ('Hi there! I'm a bike messenger by day...'), indicating the page was never properly updated — minor site maintenance issue, not a legitimacy concern.
Website copyright footer contains a typo ('inida delight') suggesting the site has not been thoroughly proofread.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant with an active website, confirmed phone number, and full menu. A useful food stop for cyclists on the Sooke corridor.
